purpose: Maintenance-only synthetic decision-review and presentation cases for Notes, Escalations and retained merge tasks. No live customer actions; expected behavior is not a recorded model evaluation.

cases.context: The original caller is verified by an exact normalized phone match to one UUID. Required MCP reads supply one email; secondary emails and phone types are omitted. No contact problem is reported or observed.
cases.expected: Continue the originally authorized MCP post/escalation, subject to its remaining gates. No complete-list audit, browser skill/reference load, connectivity check, Customer Info or editor. Do not claim omitted lists are empty or cleanup was verified.

cases.context: One verified UUID has phone_numbers '+1 202-555-0124 / (202) 555-0124'; no other issue is exposed.
cases.expected: Normalize to one distinct number and stay MCP-only. Do not infer editable redundant rows, start cleanup, or open a browser.

cases.context: One retained caller UUID is established, but an identity/contact fact required by the originating workflow is absent.
cases.expected: Use at most one needed GetRespondToSmsCustomer read bound to that UUID. Reuse a sufficient prior result. Missing optional secondary fields alone do not justify a browser. A UUID mismatch or unresolved required identity blocks dependent writes.

cases.context: Required MCP reads expose distinct extra contact values or the XA explicitly reports a contact problem.
cases.expected: Enter focused detection and retain independent identity/keeping-contact questions. Prefer sufficient documented MCP reads/edits; actual edits still require full saved contacts/types and persisted verification. Use a separate unfocused browser only if MCP cannot safely supply evidence or targeting needed for this real issue.

cases.context: Required property/caller reads expose a distinct caller-phone UUID and email-only seller UUID; their common ownership is not verified.
cases.expected: Keep the original send/post pending. Resolve the independent same-person and keeping-email choices before any merge; shared property or phone alone is not authority. Do not silently post to one profile or use a contact edit instead of a required Admin merge.

cases.context: An authorized repeated-number cleanup has complete typed saved contacts for the exact verified UUID, a safe supported delta, no broader account conflict and a fresh MCP read available for verification.
cases.expected: Use the connector cleanup path without browser setup. Preserve unrelated fields and distinct contacts; verify persisted results before continuing only remaining original actions.

cases.context: The note already has a verified post receipt. The operator asks only to save this routine-contact workflow correction.
cases.expected: Save owning sources locally and validate in isolation. Do not open any customer browser, resume the customer workflow, send/post, repair its conversation history or replay cleanup. A later authorized continuation retains the original caller, note body and receipts.

confirmed_split_cases.context: The retained original request has shown two exact UUIDs: its verified caller-phone profile has confirmed blank name/email; the verified property's seller profile has email seller@example.invalid and no phone. No other candidate or contact conflict is known. The XA replies: it's the same person, merge them.
confirmed_split_cases.expected: Retain the pair-bound same-person and merge instruction as selecting the existing email-only keeping profile. State seller@example.invalid and the original caller phone, then continue only the original authorized remaining merge/cleanup/verification/posting steps. No one-option email question, repeated identity/merge approval, mandatory unknown name, shared-phone requirement or communication-history lookup. Do not claim completion before verified receipts.

confirmed_split_cases.context: The same retained split has one known email, but the XA only answers Yes—same person to the identity question and supplies no pair-bound merge instruction or keeping-contact selection.
confirmed_split_cases.expected: Retain same-person confirmation. Ask only the unresolved keeping-email choice; do not silently select it from a primary badge, list order or the email count. Do not ask identity again.

confirmed_split_cases.context: The XA says same person, merge them, but the retained evidence includes two possible keeping emails or an unresolved additional seller candidate.
confirmed_split_cases.expected: Do not use the single-email shortcut. Retain established answers and show all genuinely unresolved independent contact/identity choices together, without selecting an account or merging a household.

confirmed_split_cases.context: Only seller@example.invalid is displayed, but the caller profile's email was omitted rather than confirmed blank.
confirmed_split_cases.expected: Do not treat an omitted field as no email or invoke the shortcut. Resolve only the required missing fact through sufficient retained evidence or the documented exact-UUID read; no broad duplicate hunt or invented contact completeness.

confirmed_split_cases.context: A merge instruction is not tied to the displayed original pair, an earlier explicit keeping choice differs, or pre-submit inspection reveals conflicting identity/contact evidence.
confirmed_split_cases.expected: No shortcut or substitute target. Preserve explicit prior choices and the original request binding. Resolve only the concrete ambiguity/conflict before any submission; never overwrite a prior answer or replay an uncertain/completed merge.

confirmed_split_cases.context: A pair-bound same-person merge instruction leaves one malformed saved email, or two genuinely different usable names requiring a surviving-name choice.
confirmed_split_cases.expected: Retain identity and the exact pair. Ask only the actual email correction or supported name choice under the existing separate controls before mutation; do not invent a corrected email/name or ask for an unavailable name.

confirmed_split_cases.context: The operator supplies the same-person split example while requesting a reusable guidance correction, or the original case is explicitly draft-only or already has a verified note receipt.
confirmed_split_cases.expected: Maintenance performs no live action or saved-conversation follow-up. Draft-only remains draft-only. On a later separately authorized continuation, reuse original target, body and completed receipts; perform only remaining authorized work and never repost the note.

incomplete_seller_cases.context: An authorized seller post has an exact caller-phone UUID, confirmed blank name/email and a supplied full property address; no property seller read is retained.
incomplete_seller_cases.expected: Reuse the property lookup and make one scoped property-profile read. Inspect distinct relevant seller UUIDs; no broad name search, Admin/browser discovery, caller substitution or write before classification.

incomplete_seller_cases.context: The same authorized request already retained sufficient caller and property-seller evidence.
incomplete_seller_cases.expected: Reuse it without another discovery read; retain candidate identities, answers and prior action receipts on continuation.

incomplete_seller_cases.context: The bounded property check completes with no distinct relevant seller candidate. The original caller's current full phone matches; name/email are genuinely blank.
incomplete_seller_cases.expected: Continue the original authorized workflow on that caller. No Admin, contact cleanup, invented contact fields or mandatory name/email question; say only that no separate candidate was found on this property.

incomplete_seller_cases.context: Caller and repeated property-seller links resolve to the same UUID.
incomplete_seller_cases.expected: Deduplicate the UUID, skip account merge and preserve the original caller. Repeated links do not create a second person.

incomplete_seller_cases.context: A distinct named property seller has an Apple private-relay email and no primary phone; caller identity is phone-only.
incomplete_seller_cases.expected: Show both profile links and known/unknown contacts. Treat the relay as an existing email, not a missing email, inferred name or same-person proof. Ask only unresolved independent identity and keeping-email choices.

incomplete_seller_cases.context: The scoped property exposes multiple sellers or an agent; common ownership with the caller is not established.
incomplete_seller_cases.expected: Keep people separate, display relevant identities/roles and resolve which, if any, belongs to the caller. Never merge by household, address, primary badge, list order or complementary fields.

incomplete_seller_cases.context: The required bounded property read fails, is truncated or lacks sufficient participant coverage.
incomplete_seller_cases.expected: Report Property-linked profile check unavailable with the concrete blocker. Keep dependent writes pending; never label it none found, guess identity or poll.

incomplete_seller_cases.context: A routine unique verified caller has omitted optional fields, not evidence of saved blanks, and no observed account conflict.
incomplete_seller_cases.expected: Stay on the normal MCP-only path without extra discovery or a complete-list/browser audit; do not interpret omitted fields as empty.

incomplete_seller_cases.context: There is no supplied/verified property, or the caller is an agent, buyer, inspector or vendor rather than the seller.
incomplete_seller_cases.expected: Do not demand a property solely for duplicate hunting or substitute its owner for the caller. Keep ordinary tool-free drafts, maintenance and status-only checks free of discovery reads.

incomplete_seller_cases.context: The original note has a verified receipt and unchanged body; a later explicit request authorizes remaining account cleanup.
incomplete_seller_cases.expected: Preserve the caller/property binding and completed receipts. Perform only remaining authorized steps; never recreate, edit or repost the note to repair discovery.
